notes.title: The gods are on your side!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - Version 0.0.23.0[/h1][h2]
[b]Major Updates[/b][/h2][h3][b]
[/b]Unreal Engine 5.6 Upgrade[/h3][list][*][p]We've upgraded the game to Unreal Engine 5.6, delivering enhanced visuals, improved performance, and new technical capabilities for a smoother and more immersive experience.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gem System Overhaul[/h3][list][*][p]Revamped Gem System, including Inventory, Gem Extractor, Gem Merger, and Gem Equipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Gems are now organized into categorized stacks instead of a single inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Gem Extractor Tool, available for purchase in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced Gem Merger Pre-Selection for better usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced gem perks for improved gameplay balance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Equipment System Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Equip items using drag-and-drop into corresponding slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced equipment perks for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted boss equipment drops to reduce Common Items, increasing chances for rarer gear.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Menu Rework[/h3][list][*][p]Completely redesigned menus with a modernized style and improved ergonomics for better navigation and user experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu animated backgrounds temporarily replaced with static images, pending Epic Games' Unreal Engine 5.6.1 update.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]New Spell: Sacred Ground added to the spell roster.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell Choice Reroll Tokens now available in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Final Boss Disintegration: Added a new effect with extended time post-victory to enjoy the spectacle.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Translation System[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new translation system to improve localization and accessibility.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Significant improvements to gameplay performance, load times, and overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Boss Area Visibility: Boss Areas are now slightly revealed when a boss is available.[/p][/*][*][p]Leveling Up: Sword now lights up during level-up for a more immersive effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Archer Behavior: Archers pass through when stopped, improving movement flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Hook Shot (ChainMaster): Removed animation stance for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Aegis of Gods Rework: Now absorbs a set amount of damage every few seconds (values TBD).[/p][/*][*][p]Aegis of Gods: Improved property descriptions for clarity.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Soul Master Enhancements:[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced Scythe collider size for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Throw Scythe spell visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand visibility in Soul Master’s AOE.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Soul Master’s lantern lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Cemetery Map: Enhanced lighting for better atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapel Cutscene: Improved lighting for a polished visual experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Gem System[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with Gem Merger Pre-Selection.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Leveling[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where gaining two levels at once only offered one upgrade choice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ability to level up while dead.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spells and Abilities[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Sacred Ground spell interrupting other spell animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip flickering for passive and active spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ultimate ability allowing jumps outside the map.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visual and Lighting Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed emissive issues for Screaming Ghosts, Flesh Heap legs, Raising Tombs, Flesh Master, and Dark Zomboids.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Flesh Heap explosion flickering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character lighting consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed light effects on Archer’s arrows.[/p][/*][*][p]Uplifted FX for ground-colliding abilities (e.g., Soul Master, Ultimate).[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced boss area visual effects for better quality.[/p][/*][/list][h3]NPC and Environment[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed NPCs spawning inside the floor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed avatar ratio in subtitle layout.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cloud Save[/h3][list][*][p]Choice Reroll amounts now save to the cloud and no longer reset.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Notes[/h3][list][*][p]The menu's animated backgrounds have been temporarily replaced with static images, pending the release of Epic Games' Unreal Engine 5.6.1 update.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for testing, and as always let us know your thoughts.[/p][p]Good luck out there![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.18.2 - Ultimate Power Awaits!
notes.content:
Hello, brave testers! Patch 0.0.18.2 has landed, and it’s a big one. I am thrilled to introduce the [b]Ultimate System[/b] and the [b]Gem Extractor[/b], alongside combat tweaks, loot boosts, and some polish to keep your runs smoother than ever. You’re the vanguard of Hell On Earth journey—let’s dive into what’s new!
    [h3]Headline Features[/h3]    [list]        [*][b]Ultimate System Unleashed![/b]
            Say hello to [u]Shockwave[/u] as your new starting [b]Ultimate Spell[/b]! Unlike regular spells, it’s with you from the first step, fueled by a shiny new resource: [b]Ultimate Power[/b]. Increase Power Orbs through combat or spellcasting—boost up to 5 to unleash a devastating Level 5 Shockwave. Oh, and it now slows enemies in its wake![/*]        [*][b]Gem Extractor Arrives[/b]
            Looted a sweet new weapon but want to keep your old gems? Grab the [b]Gem Extractor[/b] tool from the shop, crack open your gear, and reclaim those precious gems. Swap, customize, and conquer with total control![/*]    [/list]    [h3]Combat & Gameplay[/h3]    [list]        [*][b]Swordplay Upgrade[/b]
            Swords now deliver [u]Bounce Back[/u] and [u]Slow[/u] effects on hit, with slicker Paladin attack animations for chaining combos.[/*]        [*][b]Boss Area Flow[/b]
            Colliding with a Boss Area wall no longer stops you cold—momentum is yours to keep.[/*]        [*][b]Loot Buffs[/b]
            Mini-bosses now drop equipment at a 65% rate (up from 50%), and NPCs sprinkle gold into the mix.[/*]    [/list]    [h3]Quality of Life[/h3]    [list]        [*][b]Gem System Polish[/b]
            Drag-and-drop gems into slots in the Shop UI—sleek and satisfying.[/*]        [*][b]Life & Mana Pools[/b]
            Now animated with values displayed below for at-a-glance tracking.[/*]        [*][b]Gem Merge System[/b]
            Combine three gems into one stronger gem for 100 gold—power up your build![/*]    [/list]    [h3]Under the Hood[/h3]    [list]        [*][b]Unreal Engine 5.5.4[/b]
            Upgraded for better performance and stability.[/*]        [*][b]Crash Reporter[/b]
            Added to the build—it automatically reports any crash that happens in the game.[/*]        [*][b]Fixes[/b]
            [list]                [*]Squashed a crash when loading the HUD in the packaged dev version.[/*]                [*]Enemy NPCs now play attack animations properly after being interrupted.[/*]                [*]Fixed low Shadow settings not rendering some NPCs.[/*]                [*]Music dampening during Spell Choices now fades in and out smoothly with correct volume.[/*]            [/list]        [/*]    [/list]    [h3]Balance & Tweaks[/h3]    [list]        [*][b]Ultimate Invincibility Nerf[/b]
            Shortened the invincibility window—jumping on boomers now takes guts and timing![/*]        [*][b]Chest Lite[/b]
            Swapped the in-game chest model for a low-poly version to keep things running lean.[/*]        [*][b]Buy your way out[/b]
            The re-roll choice tokens must now be purchased at the shop.[/*]    [/list]
Thank you for testing the game and thank you for all your valuable feedback.
Cheers!
